title: GuardDuty, Security Hub and Inspector: findings, and what to act on first

videos.script: A security service that finds things is easy to turn on. The hard part comes a week later, when there are two hundred findings and one person. {{queue}} AWS has three such services. GuardDuty asks whether somebody is doing something bad right now. Inspector asks which software has known holes. Security Hub checks the configuration and gathers all of it into one queue. {{three}} In the lab none of them finds anything, because there is nothing real to find. So you will enable them, see what they keep, and load six findings of your own in AWS's format. {{lab}} Then the question this lesson is about: which one first. Not the most severe. The one that is happening. Then the one with a published way in. Then the rest. {{order}} You will write that order as a small program, send the urgent tier to the page from lesson fourteen, and price all three services for the shop. About a hundred and twenty-five dollars a month. {{price}}
